text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (Unstable Angina or NSTEMI). Given the classic symptoms of exertional chest pain radiating to the jaw and arm, accompanied by diaphoresis and confirmed by ST-segment depression on ECG, this is highly suggestive of cardiac ischemia.
